files.legend.sop:
@legend.calc.story core.legend
    namespace=calc.story
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    doc="Word problems. State: story (the library's storyState result carried across turns: state, steps, starts, unknown, focus), turns (how many sentences were read)."
files.operations.sop:
@op.calc.story.tell core.operation
    impl=tell
    semantics=action
    action=story.tell
    doc="A sentence of a story changes what an owner holds (has, gets, loses, gives): read by the library's storyState against the story so far; a change that takes more than the owner holds is refused with the reason."

@op.calc.story.ask core.operation
    impl=ask
    semantics=action
    action=story.ask
    doc="A question about the story: how many an owner holds (or all together, at first, how many more, who has the most), answered by storyState from the story so far."
files.patterns.sop:
# Word problems (calc.story). Every pattern hands the sentence to the library's storyState (arg.text = the segment); the words are lang.common's (ADR-007).
# The world declines a reading the library cannot read whole, or a question when no story is in focus (ops.mjs `accepts`), so the next world reads it. A question
# it keeps is one its own story answers, so its question patterns rank above the general question frames (talk's "how many legs does a spider have").

@pat.calc.story.event core.pattern
    canonical="Mia found a carrot."
    match="[$lang.lead.filler]? {who:word} [$lang.story.when]? [$lang.story.set|$lang.story.add|$lang.story.remove|$lang.story.give] {rest:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=story.tell arg.rest=\"{rest}\" arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=statement
    priority=6
    example="Tom has 15 apples."
    example="He gives 12 to Ana."
    example="Mia found a carrot."
    doc="A sentence of a story: an owner (a name, a pronoun, I, or a number as subject), a verb of holding, getting, losing or giving, an amount and an item."

@pat.calc.story.event.bare core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.filler]? {who:word} [$lang.story.when]? [$lang.story.remove|$lang.story.add]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=story.tell arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=statement
    priority=6
    example="One flies away."
    doc="A sentence of a story with a number as subject and nothing after the verb: that many of the item in focus, of the owner in focus."

@pat.calc.story.ask core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.filler]? [$lang.story.ask] {rest:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=story.ask arg.rest=\"{rest}\" arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=question
    priority=12
    example="How many apples does Tom have?"
    example="How many apples do they have together?"
    doc="A question about the story in focus: how many an owner holds, all together, at first, how many more."

@pat.calc.story.who core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.filler]? [$lang.story.who] {rest:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=story.ask arg.rest=\"{rest}\" arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=question
    priority=12
    example="Who has the most apples?"
    doc="Who of the story's owners holds the most or the least of an item."
files.world.sop:
@world.calc.story core.world
    namespace=calc.story
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.calc.story
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.lang.common
    formalization=rules
    reader=yes
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Word problems"
    summary="word problems"
    doc="A general world, not a tab (kids plan, ADR-011, Q18 L1): a story of quantities that owners hold (Tom has 15 apples. He gives 12 to Ana. How many apples does Tom have?) is read by the library's storyState, sentence by sentence and across turns (the story is the world state). The library decides the owner (a name, a pronoun for the last owner, I, or a number as subject: One flies away), the amount (a number, a or an for one) and the item, refuses giving or losing more than is held with the reason, and answers how many an owner holds, all together, at first, how many more, who has the most. Nothing here lists names or things: the number words, pronouns and function words come from the language world (w.lang.en through src/lang/en.mjs), the verbs and their effects from lang.common's phrase groups lang.story.* until k.actions has typed possession effects (Q18 K5). Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
